title: Control Plane: Path Traversal Attempt
description: Request URI contains path-traversal sequences (.. or encoded variants) — maps to the SEC-4 compliance-report traversal hardening. Any hit means a client is probing for directory escape.
query: ('Log Source' = 'SOC Control Plane Access Logs' or 'Log Source' = 'Control Plane Access Logs') and ('URI Path' like '%..%' or 'URI Path' like '%2e%2e%' or 'URI Path' like '%2f..%') | stats count as hits by 'Source IP', 'URI Path' | where hits > 0
falsepositives: Legitimate URLs that contain '..' in a query string
